subject: Permission to use Greenwave name & logos for customer story
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@greenwave.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Permission to use Greenwave name & logos for customer story

Hi Sophie —

Hope you’re well. We’ve been working on a short customer story that highlights how Greenwave Analytics reduced inference cost by 42% after migrating a portion of inference to Redwood Dedicated. The draft focuses on the integration flow and the observed unit economics improvements.

Would Greenwave be comfortable granting Redwood permission to: 1) use the Greenwave wordmark and logo on the case study landing page and PDF, and 2) include a short customer quote attributed to Greenwave Analytics?

If helpful, we can send a draft of the writeup and the exact legal language we’d like to include for approval. The customer story will live on redwood.ai/resources and may be shared in GTM materials.

Next steps we propose:
- I’ll send the draft + suggested quote text for review (today)
- If you approve, we’ll request your high-res logo files (SVG/PNG) and a signed permission doc

CCing our comms and legal folks for visibility. Thanks for considering — would love to publish this with Greenwave on a 2–3 week cadence if we get sign-off.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Appreciate the timeline — Sophie

Subject: Draft case study + requested quote text (attached)

Sophie — attaching a draft of the customer story and the suggested one-sentence quote we’d like to use.

Attachment (stub): draft-case-study-greenwave-v1.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)

Proposed quote: "Redwood’s Dedicated offering let us scale inference throughput without surprising costs — we saw a 42% reduction in per-token compute costs while hitting our latency targets." — Greenwave Analytics

For approval we need two things from Greenwave:
1) Confirmation/edits for the quote attribution (exact phrasing and whether you want job title included)
2) A signed permission confirming we can use the Greenwave name and logo in the study, in GTM collateral, and on the Redwood website (non-endorsement language is fine).

We’re aiming to publish the case study on or around 24 March if we can get approvals this week.

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 14:47:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft case study + requested quote text (attached)

Marissa / Grace —

I reviewed the draft and the proposed quote. A few legal notes before we send anything to the customer for signature:

1) Add a short permission clause that states: "Customer grants Redwood Inference the non-exclusive, royalty-free right to use Customer’s name and logo in connection with the case study and related marketing materials, provided such use does not imply endorsement beyond the scope described herein."

2) We should avoid publishing any internal metric that is not explicitly consented to. The 42% reduction is okay if Greenwave confirms the number in writing.

3) Suggest we include the option for the customer to review the final layout (PDF/landing page) prior to publication and to require 72 hours for review.

I’ve drafted a short permission paragraph you can paste into the DocuSign envelope; happy to finalize the language if Greenwave requests changes.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

- Include Redwood’s permission clause as proposed by your counsel; we request the clause include a 24-month usage window and the right to revoke with 30 days notice for material changes.
